summary: Created appworker on node1 and configured all login sessions for 8,192 open files and 256 processes. The settings persisted through the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Created appworker with home directory /home/appworker and shell /bin/bash.
Added /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf with matching soft and hard nofile and nproc limits.
Verified the limits in an actual PAM-backed appworker login session.
Safely restarted node1 and verified account, configuration, login limits, SSH service, and home directory recovery.

evidence.requirement: Create appworker and limit login sessions to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: The account and limits configuration exist; appworker login sessions report soft/hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256, including after restart.

Baseline boot ID was 96974ac3-f19e-45f7-9672-e880dd505cf8; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 30d42084-a41d-4029-89df-cfab02d61fa0; SSH, account data, home directory, configuration checksum, and requested login limits recovered.
